# Hive AI Code Mother — Spring Boot Backend Inventory

**Source root:** `d:\Liyalin\javafail\hive-ai-code-mother\src\main\java\com\hive\hiveaicodemother`  
**Global API prefix:** `http://localhost:8123/api` (from `server.servlet.context-path`)  
**Main class:** `d:\Liyalin\javafail\hive-ai-code-mother\src\main\java\com\hive\hiveaicodemother\HiveAiCodeMotherApplication.java`

---

## 1. Package Structure

| Package | Path | Purpose |
|---------|------|---------|
| *(root)* | `com.hive.hiveaicodemother` | Spring Boot entry point, `@EnableCaching`, MyBatis `@MapperScan` |
| `ai` | `...\ai\` | LangChain4j `@AiService` interfaces and factories (`AiCodeGeneratorService`, `AiCodeGenTypeRoutingService`) |
| `ai.tools` | `...\ai\tools\` | LangChain4j `@Tool` classes for Vue project file operations; `ToolManager` registry |
| `ai.model` | `...\ai\model\` | AI structured output DTOs (`HtmlCodeResult`, `MultiFileCodeResult`) |
| `ai.model.message` | `...\ai\model\message\` | Streaming message types for Vue tool-call SSE (`AiResponseMessage`, `ToolRequestMessage`, etc.) |
| `ai.memory` | `...\ai\memory\` | Custom Redis-backed `ChatMemoryStore` (`RedisTemplateChatMemoryStore`) |
| `ai.guardrail` | `...\ai\guardrail\` | Input/output guardrails (present but **commented out** in factory) |
| `annotation` | `...\annotation\` | `@AuthCheck` role annotation |
| `aop` | `...\aop\` | `AuthInterceptor` — admin role enforcement |
| `common` | `...\common\` | `BaseResponse`, `ResultUtils`, `PageRequest`, `DeleteRequest` |
| `config` | `...\config\` | Spring configuration (Redis, CORS, COS, AI models, cache) |
| `constant` | `...\constant\` | `AppConstant`, `UserConstant` |
| `controller` | `...\controller\` | REST controllers (5) |
| `core` | `...\core\` | `AiCodeGeneratorFacade` — unified code-gen orchestration; legacy `@Deprecated` parser/saver |
| `core.parser` | `...\core\parser\` | Regex-based markdown code-block parsers + `CodeParserExecutor` |
| `core.saver` | `...\core\saver\` | Template-method file savers + `CodeFileSaverExecutor` |
| `core.handler` | `...\core\handler\` | Stream post-processors for chat history persistence |
| `core.builder` | `...\core\builder\` | `VueProjectBuilder` — `npm install` + `npm run build` |
| `exception` | `...\exception\` | `BusinessException`, `ErrorCode`, `GlobalExceptionHandler`, `ThrowUtils` |
| `generator` | `...\generator\` | MyBatis-Flex code generator utility |
| `manager` | `...\manager\` | `CosManager` — Tencent COS upload |
| `mapper` | `...\mapper\` | MyBatis-Flex mappers (`AppMapper`, `UserMapper`, `ChatHistoryMapper`) |
| `model.dto.app` | `...\model\dto\app\` | App request DTOs |
| `model.dto.user` | `...\model\dto\user\` | User request DTOs |
| `model.dto.chathistory` | `...\model\dto\chathistory\` | Chat history query DTO |
| `model.entity` | `...\model\entity\` | DB entities (`App`, `User`, `ChatHistory`) |
| `model.enums` | `...\model\enums\` | `CodeGenTypeEnum`, `UserRoleEnum`, `ChatHistoryMessageTypeEnum` |
| `model.vo` | `...\model\vo\` | View objects (`AppVO`, `UserVO`, `LoginUserVO`) |
| `monitor` | `...\monitor\` | AI model Micrometer metrics (`AiModelMetricsCollector`, `AiModelMonitorListener`, `MonitorContext*`) |
| `ratelimter.annotation` | `...\ratelimter\annotation\` | `@RateLimit` |
| `ratelimter.aspect` | `...\ratelimter\aspect\` | Redisson-based rate limiting |
| `ratelimter.config` | `...\ratelimter\config\` | `RedissonConfig` |
| `ratelimter.enums` | `...\ratelimter\enums\` | `RateLimitType` (API / USER / IP) |
| `service` / `service.impl` | `...\service\` | Business services |

**Vendored LangChain4j patches** (not under `com.hive`):

---

## 2. Controllers & Endpoints

All paths below are relative to `/api`. Auth model:
- **Session auth** — `UserService.getLoginUser(request)` via Spring Session + Redis (`USER_LOGIN_STATE` session attribute)
- **Admin auth** — `@AuthCheck(mustRole = "admin")` via `AuthInterceptor`

### `HealthController` — `d:\...\controller\HealthController.java`
Base: `/health`

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|--------|------|------|-------------|
| GET | `/health/` | None | Health check, returns `"ok"` |

### `StaticResourceController` — `d:\...\controller\StaticResourceController.java`
Base: `/static`

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|--------|------|------|-------------|
| GET | `/static/{deployKey}/**` | None | Serves generated files from `CODE_OUTPUT_ROOT_DIR/{deployKey}/`; directory → `index.html`; path traversal protection |

Preview examples:
- HTML/Multi-file: `/api/static/html_{appId}/` or `/api/static/multi_file_{appId}/`
- Vue project: `/api/static/vue_project_{appId}/dist/` (after build)

### `AppController` — `d:\...\controller\AppController.java`
Base: `/app`

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|--------|------|------|-------------|
| POST | `/app/deploy` | Session (owner) | Deploy app; copies source → `CODE_DEPLOY_ROOT_DIR/{deployKey}`; Vue builds `dist/` first; async screenshot → COS cover |
| GET | `/app/download/{appId}` | Session (owner) | Download generated code as ZIP from `CODE_OUTPUT_ROOT_DIR` |
| GET | `/app/chat/gen/code` | Session (owner) + `@RateLimit` (5/min/user) | **SSE** stream AI code generation (`Flux<ServerSentEvent>`) |
| POST | `/app/add` | Session | Create app; AI routes `codeGenType` from init prompt |
| POST | `/app/delete` | Session (owner or admin) | Delete own app (cascades chat history) |
| POST | `/app/update` | Session (owner) | Update own app name only |
| GET | `/app/get/vo` | None | Get app detail VO (includes creator info) |
| POST | `/app/my/list/page/vo` | Session | Paginated list of current user's apps (max 20/page) |
| POST | `/app/good/list/page/vo` | None | Paginated **featured apps** (`priority=99`); Redis-cached via `@Cacheable` |
| POST | `/app/admin/delete` | **@AuthCheck admin** | Admin delete any app |
| POST | `/app/admin/update` | **@AuthCheck admin** | Admin update app (name, cover, priority, etc.) |
| POST | `/app/admin/list/page/vo` | **@AuthCheck admin** | Admin paginated app list |
| GET | `/app/admin/get/vo` | **@AuthCheck admin** | Admin get app detail |

### `UserController` — `d:\...\controller\UserController.java`
Base: `/user`

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|--------|------|------|-------------|
| POST | `/user/register` | None | Register (MD5+salt password) |
| POST | `/user/login` | None | Login; sets session |
| GET | `/user/get/login` | Session | Get current login user VO |
| POST | `/user/logout` | Session | Logout |
| POST | `/user/add` | **@AuthCheck admin** | Admin create user (default password `12345678`) |
| GET | `/user/get` | **@AuthCheck admin** | Admin get user by id |
| GET | `/user/get/vo` | Calls admin-only `getUserById` internally | Get user VO (requires admin) |

## 3. AI / Code Generation Architecture

### 3.1 AI Service Interfaces (LangChain4j `AiServices`)

**`AiCodeGeneratorService`** — `d:\...\ai\AiCodeGeneratorService.java`  
Built by `AiCodeGeneratorServiceFactory` (`d:\...\ai\AiCodeGeneratorServiceFactory.java`) via `AiServices.builder(...)`.

| Method | Model | Prompt file | Output |
|--------|-------|-------------|--------|
| `generateHtmlCode` | `openAiChatModel` | `prompt/codegen-html-system-prompt.txt` | `HtmlCodeResult` |
| `generateMaltiFileCode` | `openAiChatModel` | `prompt/codegen-multi-system-prompt.txt` | `MultiFileCodeResult` |
| `generateHtmlCodeStream` | streaming | same HTML prompt | `Flux<String>` |
| `generateMaltiFileCodeStream` | streaming | same multi prompt | `Flux<String>` |
| `generateVueProjectCodeStream` | reasoning streaming + tools | `prompt/codegen-vue-project-prompt.txt` | `TokenStream` |

Per-app caching: Caffeine cache keyed `{appId}_{codeGenType}` (max 1000, 30min write / 10min access TTL).  
Chat memory: `MessageWindowChatMemory` (20 messages) backed by Redis (`chat:memory:{appId}`), preloaded from DB via `ChatHistoryService.loadChatHistoryToMemory`.

**`AiCodeGenTypeRoutingService`** — `d:\...\ai\AiCodeGenTypeRoutingService.java`  
Factory: `AiCodeGenTypeRoutingServiceFactory` — uses prototype `routingChatModelPrototype`.  
Prompt: `prompt/codegen-routing-system-prompt.txt`. Returns `CodeGenTypeEnum` on app creation.

**Unused prompt files** (present in resources but not referenced):
- `d:\...\resources\prompt\codegen-multi-file-system-prompt.txt`
- `d:\...\resources\prompt\codegen-vue-project-system-prompt.txt`

**Guardrails** (implemented but commented out in factory):
- `PromptSafetyInputGuardrail` — prompt injection / length checks
- `RetryOutputGuardrail` — empty/short/sensitive output retry

### 3.2 Code Generation Types — `CodeGenTypeEnum`

`d:\...\model\enums\CodeGenTypeEnum.java`

| Enum | Value | Mode |
|------|-------|------|
| `HTML` | `html` | Single `index.html`; regex parse from markdown |
| `MULTI_FILE` | `multi_file` | `index.html` + `style.css` + `script.js` |
| `VUE_PROJECT` | `vue_project` | Full Vue project via AI tool calls into `vue_project_{appId}/` |

### 3.3 Parsers — `core/parser`

| Class | Path | Role |
|-------|------|------|
| `CodeParser<T>` | `...\core\parser\CodeParser.java` | Parser interface |
| `HtmlCodeParser` | `...\HtmlCodeParser.java` | Extracts ` ```html ` blocks |
| `MultiFileCodeParser` | `...\MultiFileCodeParser.java` | Extracts html/css/js blocks |
| `CodeParserExecutor` | `...\CodeParserExecutor.java` | **Strategy/executor** — dispatches by `CodeGenTypeEnum` |

Legacy: `core/CodeParser.java` (`@Deprecated`)

### 3.4 Savers — `core/saver`

| Class | Path | Pattern | Output dir |
|-------|------|---------|------------|
| `CodeFileSaverTemplate<T>` | `...\CodeFileSaverTemplate.java` | **Template method** | `{codeGenType}_{appId}/` under `CODE_OUTPUT_ROOT_DIR` |
| `HtmlCodeFileSaverTemplate` | `...\HtmlCodeFileSaverTemplate.java` | Saves `index.html` | `html_{appId}/` |
| `MultiFileCodeFileSaverTemplate` | `...\MultiFileCodeFileSaverTemplate.java` | Saves html/css/js | `multi_file_{appId}/` |
| `CodeFileSaverExecutor` | `...\CodeFileSaverExecutor.java` | **Executor** — dispatches by type | |

Legacy: `core/CodeFileSaver.java` (`@Deprecated`, used snowflake IDs instead of appId)

Vue projects are saved directly by AI tools (`FileWriteTool`, etc.) into `vue_project_{appId}/` — not via saver templates.

### 3.5 Facade & Builder

**`AiCodeGeneratorFacade`** — `d:\...\core\AiCodeGeneratorFacade.java`
- `generateAndSaveCode` — sync (HTML/MULTI_FILE only)
- `generateAndSaveCodeStream` — streaming for all three types
- Vue: converts `TokenStream` → JSON message `Flux`; runs `VueProjectBuilder.buildProject()` on completion

**`VueProjectBuilder`** — `d:\...\core\builder\VueProjectBuilder.java`  
Runs `npm.cmd install` (5min timeout) + `npm.cmd run build` (3min timeout); validates `dist/`.

### 3.6 LangGraph4j

**Dependency present** (`langgraph4j-core`, `langgraph4j-studio-springboot` in `pom.xml`) but **no workflow/graph/node classes exist** in the codebase. No `StateGraph`, `CompiledGraph`, or similar usage found under `src/main/java`. LangGraph4j is currently unused.

### 3.7 AI Tools — `ai/tools`

| Class | Path | Registered | Description |
|-------|------|------------|-------------|
| `BaseTool` | `...\BaseTool.java` | — | Abstract base; tool display formatting |
| `ToolManager` | `...\ToolManager.java` | — | Auto-registers all `@Component` `BaseTool` beans |
| `FileReadTool` | `...\FileReadTool.java` | Yes | Read file from `vue_project_{appId}/` |
| `FileWriteTool` | `...\FileWriteTool.java` | Yes | Write/create file in project dir |
| `FileModifyTool` | `...\FileModifyTool.java` | Yes | Find-and-replace in file |
| `FileDeleteTool` | `...\FileDeleteTool.java` | Yes | Delete file (blocks critical files like `package.json`) |
| `FileDirReadTool` | `...\FileDirReadTool.java` | Yes | List project directory tree (ignores node_modules, dist, etc.) |
| `ExitTool` | `...\ExitTool.java` | **No** (`@Component` missing) | Exit tool-call loop — not registered in Spring |

All file tools resolve paths relative to `AppConstant.CODE_OUTPUT_ROOT_DIR/vue_project_{appId}`.

### 3.8 Streaming Handling

```
AppController.chatToGenCode (SSE)
  → AppServiceImpl.chatToGenCode
    → AiCodeGeneratorFacade.generateAndSaveCodeStream
    → StreamHandlerExecutor.doExecute
       ├─ HTML/MULTI_FILE: SimpleTextStreamHandler (collect text → save chat history)
       └─ VUE_PROJECT: JsonMessageStreamHandler (parse JSON tool messages → UI + history)
```

| Component | Path | Role |
|-----------|------|------|
| SSE endpoint | `AppController` | `produces TEXT_EVENT_STREAM`; wraps chunks as `{"d": chunk}` JSON; sends `event: done` |
| `Flux<String>` | LangChain4j Reactor integration | HTML/multi streaming |
| `TokenStream` | LangChain4j | Vue tool-call streaming |
| `SimpleTextStreamHandler` | `...\core\handler\SimpleTextStreamHandler.java` | Accumulates AI text; saves to `chat_history` on complete/error |
| `JsonMessageStreamHandler` | `...\core\handler\JsonMessageStreamHandler.java` | Parses `ai_response` / `tool_request` / `tool_executed` messages |
| `StreamHandlerExecutor` | `...\core\handler\StreamHandlerExecutor.java` | Dispatches handler by `CodeGenTypeEnum` |
| `GlobalExceptionHandler` | `...\exception\GlobalExceptionHandler.java` | SSE-aware error responses (`event: business-error`) |

Stream message types (`StreamMessageTypeEnum`): `ai_response`, `tool_request`, `tool_executed`.

## 4. Business Features

### App Module — `AppService` / `AppServiceImpl`
`d:\...\service\AppService.java`, `d:\...\service\impl\AppServiceImpl.java`

- **Create** — AI-routed `codeGenType`, auto app name from first 12 chars of prompt
- **CRUD** — user-scoped update/delete; admin override endpoints
- **Featured apps** — `priority = 99` (`AppConstant.GOOD_APP_PRIORITY`); Redis-cached listing
- **Deploy** — copy to deploy dir, generate 6-char `deployKey`, async Selenium screenshot → COS cover
- **Download** — ZIP of generated source (filters node_modules, dist, etc.)
- **AI chat codegen** — streaming SSE with rate limiting
- **Cascade delete** — removing app deletes associated chat history

### User Module — `UserService` / `UserServiceImpl`
`d:\...\service\UserService.java`, `d:\...\service\impl\UserServiceImpl.java`

- Register / login / logout (session-based, 30-day cookie)
- MD5+salt (`"hive"`) password hashing
- Roles: `user` / `admin`
- Admin CRUD + paginated VO list
- Legacy scaffold endpoints (unauthenticated) still present

### ChatHistory Module — `ChatHistoryService` / `ChatHistoryServiceImpl`
`d:\...\service\ChatHistoryService.java`, `d:\...\service\impl\ChatHistoryServiceImpl.java`

- Persist user/AI messages per app
- Load history into LangChain4j memory (excludes latest user message)
- Cursor pagination by `lastCreateTime`
- Admin search/list
- Delete by appId on app removal

## 7. Static Resource / Deploy

Constants — `d:\...\constant\AppConstant.java`:

| Constant | Value | Purpose |
|----------|-------|---------|
| `CODE_OUTPUT_ROOT_DIR` | `{user.dir}/tmp/code_output` | **Preview / generation** root |
| `CODE_DEPLOY_ROOT_DIR` | `{user.dir}/tmp/code_deploy` | **Deploy** copy destination |
| `CODE_DEPLOY_HOST` | `http://localhost` | Deploy URL host (no port/path) |
| `GOOD_APP_PRIORITY` | `99` | Featured app marker |
| `DEFAULT_APP_PRIORITY` | `0` | Normal app |

**Directory naming:**
- HTML: `tmp/code_output/html_{appId}/index.html`
- Multi-file: `tmp/code_output/multi_file_{appId}/`
- Vue: `tmp/code_output/vue_project_{appId}/` (tools write here; build produces `dist/`)
- Deploy: `tmp/code_deploy/{deployKey}/` (Vue deploys `dist/` contents)

**Serving:**
- Preview only via `StaticResourceController` → reads **`CODE_OUTPUT_ROOT_DIR`**, not deploy dir
- Deploy returns URL `http://localhost/{deployKey}/` — **no backend controller serves `CODE_DEPLOY_ROOT_DIR`** (likely expects external static server/nginx)

**Deploy flow** (`AppServiceImpl.deployApp`):
1. Verify owner + source exists
2. Vue: build project, use `dist/` as source
3. Copy to `CODE_DEPLOY_ROOT_DIR/{deployKey}`
4. Save `deployKey` + `deployedTime`
5. Async screenshot deployed URL → COS → update `cover`

## Key Documentation Notes for README

1. **`application.yml` is gitignored** — provide an `application.yml.example` for onboarding.
2. **LangGraph4j** is on the classpath but **not implemented** — Vue codegen uses LangChain4j tools + `TokenStream` instead.
3. **Preview vs deploy** use different directories and URL schemes; deploy URL may need external static hosting.
4. **Vue project dir** (`vue_project_{appId}`) differs from HTML/multi (`{type}_{appId}`).
5. **Tech stack** (from `pom.xml`): Spring Boot 3.5.16, Java 21, MyBatis-Flex 1.11, LangChain4j 1.1.0, Redisson 3.50, Selenium 4.33, Tencent COS SDK, Caffeine, Micrometer/Prometheus, Knife4j 4.4.
